Your Link Name Share this page on your favorite Social network Facebook Twitter Reddit Close slide 1 of 1 Department Menu Land Transfers & Forms Fee Schedules Recording Requirements Passports Register of Deeds Online Search Home Departments Register of Deeds Register of Deeds slide 1 to 2 of 2 Search Deeds - Online Access Learn More Property Fraud Alert Learn More The Register of Deeds office is the official recording office for all legal documents affecting real property. The duties of the Register of Deeds are prescribed by state law. Documents are recorded by a uniform system and statutory fees set by the state legislature. The Register of Deeds office does not prepare documents or answer legal questions. Please see an attorney for document preparation and legal advice. SERVICES: Recording of legal documents which include but are not limited to: warranty deeds, quit claim deeds, mortgages, mortgage assignments, mortgage discharges, land contracts, liens, lien releases, easements, right of ways, oil and gas leases, subdivision plats, surveys, land corners, and court orders that affect real property.
